bots.name: Close Sentinel
bots.tagline: Watches every close feed, reconciles, and locks the period when it is clean.
bots.trigger: Stream on BC GL + Omnium POS landing tables

steps.label: Completeness DMFs per feed
steps.result: BC GL 66.7% — OData API timeout after 1.4M of 2.1M lines

steps.label: Fallback: paged extract from Data Lake replica
steps.result: 0.7M lines backfilled · reconciled to BC trial balance, difference NOK 0.0M

steps.label: Reconcile: 3-way match + store-owner intercompany
steps.result: Auto-match 93.8% · unmatched NOK 84.7M · IC mismatch NOK 11.5M (14 store owners)

steps.label: Guardrail: completeness ≥ 98% and TB difference = 0
steps.sql: SELECT MIN(completeness) >= 0.98 AND ABS(SUM(tb_diff)) = 0 FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_CLOSE_STATUS WHERE period = '2026-10';

guardrails.label: Trial balance tie-out
guardrails.rule: Backfill must reconcile to BC TB

approval.title: Lock period October 2026
approval.detail: All 12 feeds ≥ 98% complete after the Data Lake backfill of the BC GL. TB difference NOK 0.0M. 14 store-owner IC items (NOK 11.5M) carried as open items with owners.

bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the price/volume/mix bridge and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Price / volume / mix bridge by brand × category
steps.sql:
SELECT brand, category,
  (act_units - bud_units) * bud_asp            AS volume_eff,
  (act_asp - bud_asp) * act_units              AS price_eff,
  mix_eff, act_gm - bud_gm                     AS gm_var
FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_PVM_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
steps.result: Sales NOK 499M vs budget · GM 36.1% · largest driver: Ski volume in Trøndelag

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ NOK 1M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.PVM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e6 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers selected — stockouts lost GM, Anton promo, owned vs associated mix

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (184 words) · numeric check: 11/11 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to Close Control + dashboard
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('close-control', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Price / volume / mix bridge by brand × category
SELECT brand, category,
  (act_units - bud_units) * bud_asp            AS volume_eff,
  (act_asp - bud_asp) * act_units              AS price_eff,
  mix_eff, act_gm - bud_gm                     AS gm_var
FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_PVM_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ NOK 1M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.PVM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e6 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write CFO commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.PVM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'PVM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Close Control + dashboard
INSERT INTO SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('close-control', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

Roll RF: actuals Jan–Sep + ML Oct–Dec

approval.title: Promote RF10 as current forecast
approval.detail: Actuals Jan–Sep + SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST Oct–Dec. Backtest MAPE ≤1.4% by brand. FY sales NOK 6,775M vs Q3F 6,780M (−0.1%), driven by Trøndelag ski cover risk.

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per brand × category
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.M_SALES_FC(

-- step 5 · Promote RF10 to current forecast (approval)

bots.name: GL Mapper
bots.tagline: Classifies new and unmapped accounts with AI_CLASSIFY; applies only high-confidence mappings.
bots.trigger: New account in BC chart of accounts

steps.label: Unmapped accounts detected
steps.result: 9 new BC accounts (Sport 1 store-owner marketing fund + 2 Omnium fee codes)

steps.label: AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
steps.result: 7 auto-applied · 2 sent for review (marketing fund → COGS or OpEx?)

steps.label: Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Any account with balance above this goes to review

approval.title: Map 2 Sport 1 marketing-fund accounts
approval.detail: AI_CLASSIFY proposes COGS — supplier marketing contributions (confidence 0.81). Consistent with the Anton Sport reclass in this close.

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Oslo'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_leaf)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_SH_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

bots.name: Stockout Sentry
bots.tagline: Daily ski cover check by store before peak season; quantifies gross margin at risk.

steps.label: Weeks of cover by store × category
steps.sql: SELECT store, category, on_hand / NULLIF(fc_weekly_units,0) AS cover_wk FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_COVER WHERE category = 'Ski';

steps.label: GM at risk before week 50
steps.sql: SELECT SUM(gm_at_risk) FROM SDP_SH_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_STOCKOUT_RISK WHERE week <= 50;
steps.result: NOK 8.6M at risk · 5 stores hold NOK 10.4M of sales exposure

steps.label: Draft transfer + reorder proposal

guardrails.label: Cover floor
guardrails.rule: Alert when weeks of cover below
